verdict_scope: P-C5.1-3 are scored on the released pairs, 1%, selected C, item level, the primary class, pooled point estimates; every other row (C=1, cluster level, 5%, LoRA, the GPU control, the unflagged pairs, other classes) is beside, never a verdict (D-381 (4))
band_note: per-draw bands cover partitions only, pooled intervals cover pairs only (D-166); the nine LoRA runs share one pre model, so a run-cluster interval covers variation between runs only (D-278)
bbse: D-381 (2)(c) as amended by D-392 (1): BBSE (arXiv:1802.03916) is computed BESIDE as a ranking line, with no flag (no registered cut), and does not enter P-C5.3. Per cell, draw and seed the estimated harmful share on the benign reference w = (r_post - r_pre) / (TPR_pre - r_pre): r the share of cal_d at or above T_d under a model, floored at 1/n (4c's direct ratio's r); TPR_pre the share of the calibration positives at or above T_d under the pre model, unfloored; undefined when TPR_pre <= r_pre (counted); the cell's value is the mean over the seeds with a defined estimate, and a cell with none is left out of that draw's ROC AUC (counted per row); ROC score |w|. Within one cell, draw and seed (r_pre, TPR_pre fixed) w is an increasing affine function of r_post, and w >= w_c if and only if r_post / r_pre >= 1 + w_c (TPR_pre - r_pre) / r_pre; across a row's cells it is not a function of the direct ratio (TPR_pre differs by cell, the direct ratio is a mean over seeds), so its ranking can differ. Its premise, p(x | y) unchanged across the shift, is what a backbone update breaks: the scores of both classes move.
ks: D-381 (2)(a): the two-sample KS test (arXiv:1810.11953, BBSDs + KS) on the probe score of cal_d, pre against post, per seed; the flag is the mean of D over seeds > 1.358 sqrt((n + m) / (n m)) (alpha 0.05, asymptotic). Stated, not corrected: the two samples are the same prompts, which the test's independence premise does not cover; it is applied as a deployer would apply it.

summary_anchor.rule: this module's pooling of the records' Gaussian and direct counts equals the 4c summaries' released-pair, unflagged-pair, GPU-control and (1%) LoRA blocks exactly; its ROC path on the released pairs' 4c scores (their anchored 4c npz) equals those summaries' ROC blocks and cell counts (released and unflagged rows, both targets); every KS and ATC row covers the 4c row's cells; each unit's ks_mean_D arrays are the same bytes at 1% and 5% (CHOICES 10, 12, 17)
